metadata.description: Codech internal Claude Code plugins — workflows, skills, and tools used across client engagements.

plugins.name: codech-project-superpower
plugins.description: End-to-end engagement workflow: turns raw requirements (docx, pdf, meeting notes) into a styled bilingual proposal (MD + HTML + PDF), pre-development documents (FSD, SAD, TDD, SRS), and an interactive single-file React prototype — then carries the approved package through production development (master plan + gated TDD sub-plans, prototype as pixel-diff contract). Orchestrates docx, brainstorming, ui-ux-pro-max, and the superpowers writing-plans/executing-plans/subagent-driven-development/finishing-a-development-branch skills.

plugins.name: fintech-compliance-copy
plugins.description: Design, build, and keep regulator-safe a crypto / digital-asset / payment / fintech marketing website. Build a new payment-platform site to a proven institutional design standard with compliance baked in, or apply a lawyer/compliance review to an existing one — remove live trading/FX/price displays, mark unlaunched services (virtual accounts, IBAN, cards, settlement rails) as not currently available, add no-advice / no-banking / not-an-endorsement disclaimers, insert legal-approved wording verbatim.

plugins.name: codech-client-proposal
plugins.description: Packages a Codech engagement into a deployed, client-shareable HTML proposal. Applies a per-client design system to the canonical proposal anatomy (utility bar, hero, modules, architecture, scope, pricing, closing), captures prototype screenshots via Playwright, deploys to Cloudflare Pages with a *.pages.dev URL. The delivery layer that follows codech-project-superpower and codech-mockup-design.

plugins.name: codech-web-builder
plugins.description: Turn reference website(s) + a brand logo into a deployed site: vision-extracted palette, taste-skill design system + HTML prototype, then convert to a target stack (WordPress or static) and deploy. Stack-agnostic via a portable core + thin adapters; two human gates (after design, before deploy). Use when building or designing a site like a reference, deriving a brand palette from a logo, or converting an approved design into WordPress or a static site and deploying it.

plugins.name: codech-mockup-design
plugins.description: Structured design ideation and visual prototyping workflow. Creates design system documents (tokens, principles, accessibility rules) and self-contained HTML showcases that render live in any browser — no build step. Supports multiple design directions with mandatory 7-axis differentiation, optional interactive Framer Motion + shadcn/ui prototypes, and AI-generated brand imagery via Hugging Face Inference API.

plugins.name: codech-cinematic-web
plugins.description: Build cinematic marketing-page effects: a Three.js hero object (dot-matrix planet, orb, product form) lit by one analytic screen-space atmosphere, and a sticky scroll deck where one gesture advances exactly one panel over full-bleed video. Ships working reference implementations plus the measurement scripts that catch the failures these effects are prone to - shell-banded glow, viewport-dependent brightness, position-based snapping that skips panels, and video that silently never plays on iOS.

plugins.name: codech-web-hardening
plugins.description: Harden and stabilise a live web server (WordPress/PHP behind Caddy, nginx, Apache or cPanel, usually fronted by Cloudflare) without taking it down. Break-glass-first safety order, capacity triage (php-fpm workers vs RAM — the usual root cause of OOM loops), fail2ban jails driven by the reverse proxy's own access log, locking the origin to CDN ranges, origin + edge page caching, a self-healing watchdog, and the shared-IP rules that make per-IP defences dangerous during campaign and event spikes. Also covers safe load testing on production, plus audit and staged remediation runbook templates.
